title: Asking for Food
label: ch:ar-asking-for-food
canDo: I can ask for salt, meat, cheese and food in Arabic, and I can build the word for a restaurant myself out of a root and the ma- place shape.

payoff.summary: Name ط as the emphatic partner of ت beside ص under س and ض under د, then pour ط-ع-م through the ma- place shape that already gave maktab and madhhab to generate maṭʿam, 'a restaurant', and ask for the chapter's foods with min faḍlik.
